test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FINGER' is written as 'HHPIDT' and 'DESTINY' is written as FDUVHPA'. How will 'GRANTED' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

**Logic: **

**Step 1: Addition of +2 in the consonant alphabet.**

**Step 2: Subtraction of -1 in the vowel alphabet.**

'FINGER' is written as 'HHPIDT' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/820607665ea176d8bb70538f146f5c5a61f2236c03ac76a9516142bdd08ed4d7.png] 

And,

'DESTINY' is written as FDUVHPA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e14c31f40186b990a082747b7044ff13ecc779d0ceecbe39e3e51003ef1ea89.png] 

Similarly,

'GRANTED' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4da7a9a3c3b486e203ea7f0080b57c6123360133da907ab5dba4dfd92b28234.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ITZPVDF".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** With the two hints given another pattern is getting formed which is:

Step 1: Dividing the entire word into sections of 3 letters each 

Step 2: Addition of +2 in 1st and 3rd letter and subtraction of -1 from 2nd letter

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e8d3ed1f0ad75b4fbe43f289112d5ce46a00233da89773dde64163c3177ed12.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bedcee8f66a9dcac6e1ff780790520152bd2f6c7b90449107f853558ea3e3f6.png] 

By doing this you will get **IQC** for the first three letters (as given in option 3) but the same will not be continued for the remaining letters hence 1st logic follows correctly and gives 1st option as the correct one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/454bcef4dd46f356b759f5fb28629b999804e6903923a12237371d1ca9f54428.png] 

**IQCPSGR is not present in the options. It is different from option C.**
